TAL_ATHLETICS_UNWILLING_BOOST.why: Real OA hit or Bonus Action miss conversion grants round-scoped horizontal or half vertical movement; allies may assist with their Reaction.

TAL_ATHLETICS_SURE_GRIP.why: Athletics climb/fall checks have Advantage; physical Grapples survive Incapacitated. Held objects are not automatically dropped by these conditions.

TAL_ATHLETICS_STRONG_LUNGS.why: Advantage against inhalation and suffocation; CON Advantage against forced-march Exhaustion. Explicit breath holding tracks remaining seconds, multiplied by Proficiency Bonus.

TAL_ATHLETICS_SHARK_SWIM.why: Swim Speed equals land Speed. With Strong Lungs, hold breath for Constitution modifier hours, at least one hour.
